blurb: Emerald City Harbor is a full service marina located in the heart of the Nautical Mile in Michigan. They offer over 500 boat wells, summer docking, winter storage, boat and yacht brokerage, and a service center. Amenities include a gas dock, pump-out facility, boat hoist, gazebo, and picnic areas.
